name: Priority Jewels Limited
summary: Priority Jewels Limited designs, makes and sells diamond-studded gold and platinum fine jewellery in India, including rings, earrings, pendants, mangalsutras, bracelets and customized lab-grown diamond pieces. It supplies jewellery chains such as CaratLane, Kalyan Jewellers and Senco Gold as well as independent jewellers, and exports to markets including Australia, Hong Kong and the United States.
